structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page only gives you ways to go further (a search box, buttons for savings types, a top menu) and no answer for someone putting 300–500 ₪ a month. If I did anything, I'd tap "השקעה במדד" in the top menu.

stuck.why: None of them says ETF, S&P or Nasdaq, so I couldn't tell which one is the thing the creators talk about. Maybe 'חשבון ניירות ערך'?
'השקעה במדד' looks like the relevant one, but it's small text in the menu and easy to miss
I don't have a company or product yet, so I wasn't sure it's for me

not_found: Any mention of ETF, S&P 500, Nasdaq or index fund in words I know
Anything about small monthly amounts (300–500 ₪) and whether it's worth it
Any number at all: fees, returns, an example
A place to type my monthly amount

findings.what: The home page gives no answer or starting point for 'I have a few hundred ₪ a month, what do I do'. It's all navigation
'השקעה במדד', the most relevant entry for me, is hidden as small text in the top menu instead of being a main button
The savings-type chips use Hebrew terms I don't know and give no English or plain hint (ETF, S&P), so I can't pick one
The tagline promises 'מקור לכל מספר', but there are no numbers on the screen to hook me
'מה חברה מציעה לי' assumes I already have a company or product
On a wide screen the right half is empty and the content sits small on the left; it looks unfinished
